Owens & Minor
distributes
over 200,000 to 360,000 active medical and surgical products sourced from roughly 1,200 to 1,400 diverse third-party healthcare manufacturers
, alongside its own proprietary product lines. Rather than publishing a fixed, public directory of every single vendor, they partner broadly across the medical device and consumable spectrum.
Owens & Minor
Proprietary and Flagship Brands
Owens & Minor manufactures and distributes several in-house and acquired flagship brands:
HALYARD*:
Surgical and infection prevention solutions, facial protection, surgical drapes, and exam gloves.
MediChoice:
A vast portfolio of thousands of patient care, surgical, and minor medical-surgical supplies.
Medical Action:
Procedural accessories and operating room items.
HALYARD
Distributed Third-Party Products
The company handles a massive range of national name-brand supplies utilized in acute and non-acute care settings, which include:
OpenText
Surgical dressings and sutures
Needles, syringes, and intravenous (IV) products
Personal protective equipment (PPE)
Physician preference items and specialized sterile procedure trays

Owens & Minor
is a major healthcare logistics and medical supply distribution company. It distributes hundreds of thousands of stock-keeping units (SKUs) from
over a thousand name-brand manufacturer partners
, alongside its own proprietary product brands.
Owens & Minor
Proprietary & Flagship Brands
HALYARD*:
Surgical and infection-prevention solutions, including medical drapes, gowns, and face masks.
MediChoice:
Owens & Minor's own brand of high-quality medical and surgical disposable products.
Medical Action:
Procedural readiness and surgical accessories.
